home-redirect.name: Home redirects by session
home-redirect.description: Opening / sends visitors without a session to /sign-in and signed-in operators to /dashboard

auth-sign-in-form.name: Sign-in form display and interaction
auth-sign-in-form.description: Operator opens /sign-in, can type in the form and an empty submission keeps them on the page

auth-login-invalid.name: Login with invalid credentials
auth-login-invalid.description: Operator submits rejected credentials, sees the error and stays on /sign-in

auth-login-success.name: Login with valid credentials
auth-login-success.description: Operator submits accepted credentials and lands on the /dashboard console

auth-protected-redirect.name: Protected route redirect
auth-protected-redirect.description: Opening /dashboard without a session redirects to /sign-in

auth-sign-out.name: Sign out from the console
auth-sign-out.description: Signed-in operator uses the header sign-out button and returns to /sign-in

auth-forgot-password-form.name: Forgot password form display
auth-forgot-password-form.description: Operator follows the sign-in link to /forgot-password and sees the reset form

auth-forgot-password-send-code.name: Forgot password sends the passcode
auth-forgot-password-send-code.description: Operator requests a passcode and moves to the code and new-password step; a backend failure shows an error

dashboard-empty-state.name: Console empty state
dashboard-empty-state.description: Signed-in operator sees the Fiscal. console with the empty documents state

console-dashboard-counters.name: Dashboard counters
console-dashboard-counters.description: Signed-in operator sees the documents by state, issuers, client systems, the transmission queue and the latest rejection on /dashboard

console-dashboard-retry.name: Dashboard retry after a failure
console-dashboard-retry.description: The summary request fails, the operator sees the error and the retry button loads the counters

console-documents-filter.name: Filter the document list
console-documents-filter.description: Operator opens Documents from the header and filters the list by state or by issuer NIT

console-documents-pagination.name: Paginate the document list
console-documents-pagination.description: Operator moves to the next page of documents and back with Siguiente and Anterior

console-document-detail.name: Document detail
console-document-detail.description: Operator opens a document from the list and sees its data, CUFE, DIAN errors, artifacts and event history

console-document-not-found.name: Document not found
console-document-not-found.description: Opening /documents/<id> for a document that does not exist shows the not-found message

i18n-locale-switch.name: Switch the interface language
i18n-locale-switch.description: Operator switches the interface from Spanish (default) to English

navigation-unknown-route.name: Unknown route returns 404
navigation-unknown-route.description: Navigating to an undefined URL returns an HTTP 404 status instead of a broken 200/500

console-document-download.name: Download a document artifact
console-document-download.description: Operator opens a document and downloads its signed XML (or PDF, AttachedDocument, DIAN answer, evidence) through the authenticated API

console-dashboard-health.name: Dashboard alerts and service health
console-dashboard-health.description: Operator sees open alerts, the 24-hour rejection rate and whether the worker and the DIAN are healthy

console-issuers-list.name: Issuer list and search
console-issuers-list.description: Operator lists the issuers with their certificate expiry and open alerts and searches them by NIT or name

console-issuer-detail.name: Issuer detail
console-issuer-detail.description: Operator opens an issuer and sees its data, certificates, registered software, range usage and open alerts

console-contingency-letter.name: Contingency letter draft
console-contingency-letter.description: Operator downloads the draft of the issuer's contingency letter to the DIAN for a period; reversed dates show an error

console-contingencies.name: Contingency board
console-contingencies.description: Operator opens the invoices waiting for the DIAN with their 48-hour clock and goes to the document

console-alerts-resolve.name: Alerts and resolution
console-alerts-resolve.description: Operator lists the open alerts, resolves one and can include the resolved ones

console-client-systems.name: Client systems
console-client-systems.description: Operator sees each client system with its notice URL, valid secrets and pending or failed notices

console-onboarding.name: Enrol an issuer
console-onboarding.description: Operator enrols a new business step by step: client system (secret shown once), issuer data, certificate upload, DIAN software and habilitación range

console-test-set.name: Run the DIAN test set
console-test-set.description: Operator starts the issuer's DIAN test set and asks the DIAN for its result
